title: Going and Coming
label: ch:ar-going-and-coming
canDo: I can say the Arabic for 'he went' and 'he came', read the three-consonant root under each, and explain why Arabic dictionaries list a verb as 'he did' rather than 'to do'.

payoff.summary: Say the going/coming pair, name the weak letter that vanishes from jāʾa and point to where it comes back, and restate the root-and-pattern engine dhahaba opened.
